# `adi-events` — types

> A tiny, decoupled event bus for the adi platform: publishers `emit(name, payload)` a named event (e.g. `adi.tasks.created`) as one JSON record spooled under ~/.adi/mono/events, and a consumer drains the spool and delivers each to whoever subscribed. Publishers depend only on this crate (which depends only on adi-config) — they never know a subscriber exists. Event names are dotted topics matched with segment-aware glob patterns (`*` = one segment, `**` = the tail).

## `src/catalog.rs`

### struct `EventType`

One kind of event the platform publishes, for display in the editor, the CLI, and the agent's system prompt. A producer builds it from its payload's own Rust type via `EventType::new`, so the schema and example are generated, never hand-maintained.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct EventType {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub summary: &'static str,
    pub schema: Value,
    pub example: Value,
}
```

### type `Result`

The result type every fallible `adi-events` operation returns.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

### enum `Error`

Everything that can go wrong emitting or draining events.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Error {
    InvalidName(String),
    Config(adi_config::Error),
    Io(std::io::Error),
    Encode(serde_json::Error),
}
```

### struct `EventRecord`

One published event: a dotted topic `name`, a JSON `payload` string (opaque to the bus — the subscriber parses it), and when it was emitted.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct EventRecord {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub payload: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub emitted_at: u64,
}
```

### struct `SpooledEvent`

A record as it sits in the spool: the file backing it (pass to `Events::remove` once delivered) and the parsed `EventRecord`.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SpooledEvent {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub record: EventRecord,
}
```

### struct `Events`

The event bus: emits records into, and drains records out of, the `events` spool directory. Cheap to clone; all state is on disk.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Events {
    config: Config,
}
```
